content.text: The licence clause already meets our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote:
13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 13 satisfies the preferred position in full: (i) 13.1 grants the subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (and Authorized Users), with no "non-transferable", "revocable" or narrow "internal use only" limitation; (ii) 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and fully paid, including contractor support rights, and 14.3 confirms that licence covers Vendor Technology needed to use Deliverables; (iii) 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 (which allows consent-free assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor under 24.1), and limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. "Affiliate" is defined on standard control terms without carve-outs. No licence-scope deviation to redline.</rationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9
